findings.summary: outcome read duplicates the module's _read at pending_landing.py:739
findings.text: non-blocking: _finished_group_landings reads and parses the JSON object itself instead of calling the module's own _read at :739, which owns exactly that read; a later change to the shared read (encoding, error handling, logging) will not reach this path, so two readers of the same record shape can drift.

findings.summary: test builds the outcome record it reads, so a producer shape change is untested
findings.text: non-blocking: the fixture fabricates the landing-group outcome record that the new reader consumes, so the test proves the reader against a hand-written shape rather than against what the two production writers emit (pending_landing.py:236 and crew_run_commands.py:4842 keep members and commits as parallel ordered lists), and tests/test_a_landing_group_ends_when_its_members_land.py:176 pins only the members set, so a writer reordering the two lists would pair a member with another member's head and could release a pointer whose own head is not on the branch.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from b8d76fea6133 to 06e6a5410d; 3155dd788a adds the finished-group reader, the release pass and three tests, 1c78c0639b and 06e6a5410d add and then refine the evidence fragment's quoted arms, and no other file changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a three-member group with one request waiting on each member, merged and unmerged; tests/test_a_landed_group_releases_every_member.py:222-232 asserts no member pointer survives and all three waiter pointers read phase queued for the merged case, :229-236 keeps every pointer and every wait for the unmerged case, and the negative-control log records 2 failed, 1 passed at the base revision.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a group whose head is on the primary branch retires every member pointer and releases every section waiting on a member; reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:626-629 routes a journal-less group into _retire_members_of_a_finished_group, which at :579 checks each member's recorded head for that run with merge._is_ancestor before calling the existing _release_integrated_group_member, so the release uses the same workspace, receipt and waiter path a live-journal release uses.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the scoped gate at 61 passed exit 0, the baseline arm at 58 passed exit 0, the after arm at 61 passed exit 0 and the negative control at 2 failed 1 passed exit 1, each with a log path whose header revision and closing EXIT= line I confirmed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five write paths; the diff touches reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, tests/test_a_landed_group_releases_every_member.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared set, and leaves reckon/crew/promotion_release.py and the figures directory untouched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_landed_group_releases_every_member.py:225 and :236 redden at the base revision as the negative control shows, but the test's outcome record at :203 is fabricated by the test itself, so no test would notice a production writer whose members and commits lists stopped agreeing.
justifications.evidence: the merged and unmerged cases plus the base negative control are all recorded with their log paths, and the suite arms ran on 98dci4-clu-3141 rather than the dispatching worker's node, so the done_when's all_debug venue is met.
justifications.fit: the addition follows the module's private-helper idiom and lazy imports at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:550-585, and carries no plan, ticket or release identifier in its names, docstrings or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:579 gates every member release on merge._is_ancestor, so a member whose head is not on the primary branch keeps its pointer, which is the deliverable's stated limit.
justifications.reuse: the release itself extends the existing owner at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:173 and reuses merge._is_ancestor and queue_landing._primary_revision, but _finished_group_landings re-implements the JSON-object read that this module already owns at :739.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the two declared paths the change does not need were left untouched.
